subject.title: feat(ios): haptic feedback for chat send, completion, and failure

question: After the abort-classification blockers are fixed, should the shared iOS chat package accept default-on structured chat haptics and the new public `OpenClawChatHaptics` API now?
rationale: The remaining code repair is mechanical, but the PR adds new user-visible iOS behavior and public shared package surface while carrying the protected maintainer label.

options.title: Accept after abort fixes
options.body: Land the feature once live aborted events and persisted abort rows both map to failure haptics with focused Swift coverage.

options.title: Require an opt-out first
options.body: Ask for a settings or policy surface before enabling chat haptics by default for all iOS users.

options.title: Defer haptics
options.body: Pause or close the haptics feature until maintainers re-scope iOS chat polish direction.

recommendation.title: Accept after abort fixes
recommendation.body: Land the feature once live aborted events and persisted abort rows both map to failure haptics with focused Swift coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: @steipete owns the umbrella request, authored this candidate PR, and appears in recent history for the affected shared chat surface.
